title: Harden-Hayes earns MVP as Sporting hold off Benfica in Mother's Day thriller to claim third Taca Hugo dos Santos
description: Sporting CP captured their third Taca Hugo dos Santos with a nerve-shredding 79-77 victory over rivals SL Benfica at the Pavilhao Multiusos de Gondomar on Sunday, composure from the free-throw line in the dying seconds securing the Leoes' second trophy of the 2025-26 season in front of 1,067 fans. The final was a fitting spectacle for a special occasion â€” played on Dia da Mae (Mother's Day), the pre-game introductions saw each player presented alongside the name of their mother in a touching tribute that set the tone for an emotional afternoon.

title: Benfica celebrate third consecutive Liga Betclic title
description: FC Porto - Benfica 71-93 Benfica clinched the third consecutive Liga Betclic title. They outscored FC Porto on the road in Game 4 to defend the trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Benfica. FC Porto managed to win third quarter 23-20. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They outrebounded FC Porto 43-22 including a 29-17 advantage in defensive rebounds. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international Betinho Gomes (201-1985) who helped to win the game recording 24 points and 8 rebounds. American guard Ahmaad Rorie (186-1995, college: Montana) contributed with 13 points, 5 rebounds and 6 assists for the winners. Four Benfica players scored in double figures. title: Benfica celebrate third consecutive Liga Betclic title
description: Benfica - FC Porto 83-76 Benfica celebrated the third consecutive Liga Betclic title. They overcame FC Porto at home court tonight to complete the sweep of the championship series and to repeat as the champions. FC Porto was trailing by 6 points at halftime but managed to get 3-point lead after three quarters before a 27-17 charge of Benfica, which allowed them to win the game. 25 personal fouls committed by FC Porto helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a great evening for American Trey Drechsel (198-1996, college: GCU, agency: Worldwide SM) who led his team to a victory scoring 23 points and 6 rebounds. His fellow American import guard Aaron Broussard (196-1990, college: Seattle, agency: Worldwide SM) helped adding 21 points and 6 rebounds. Five Benfica players scored in double figures. title: Sporting crowned LBP champions
description: Sporting - FC Porto 86-85 Sporting are the new LPB champions. They edged FC Porto in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the trophy. The hosts took control from the first minutes by winning first half. But FC Porto won fourth quarter 22-18. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Jalen Riley (182-PG-93, college: ETSU) gave FC Porto an 85-83 lead with 17 seconds to go. Shakir Smith (185-PG-92, college: ASU) converted a layup at the other end to draw things even at 85. Garrett Nevels (188-G-92, college: Hawaii) missed a late jumper for FC Porto and Eric Anderson fouled Micah Downs (203-F-86, college: Gonzaga) with one second left in regulation.
